conditions: Nodes inside each region unlock in order, so clear the earlier nodes to reach the Survival and Defense ones.
bonuses: A basic Railjack with Mk III dojo parts and three hired Ticker crew from Fortuna is enough for the space phase.

conditions: The Railjack nodes only drop the three components.
This is Venus Proxima, a Railjack region. Tessera and the regular Venus nodes do not drop Ash.
Both A rolls land in the first 10 minutes. Extract at 10, or stay to 25-30 for the next pair; B and C at 15 and 20 are wasted.
bonuses: Venus Proxima is open by default. Void Storms on these nodes add relic rewards, and the runs level a Necramech or other gear.

disclosures.title: why Survival, not Defense
disclosures.body: Falling Glory (Defense) drops the same part, but the two-floor Corpus ship tileset strands enemies far from the objective and stalls waves by minutes. You cannot return to space mid-objective, so a stuck wave stalls the whole run. Khora with Pilfering Strangledome in a dead-end room covers life support solo; enemies are only about level 22-43.

disclosures.title: Exterminate and Volatile
disclosures.body: The same regions' Exterminate and Volatile nodes drop the part on completion, but at only about 4.7-4.9%.

conditions: Needs Railjack Intrinsic rank 3. Arva Vector is the Defense node for the same part.
Needs Railjack Intrinsic rank 5. Obol Crossing is the Defense node for the same part.

disclosures.title: Circuit week 3 does all of this
disclosures.body: After The Duviri Paradox, pick Ash in the normal Circuit during week 3 of the 11-week rotation, alongside Frost and Nyx. Neuroptics at tier 2 (400 progress), Chassis 5 (1,190), Systems 8 (2,430), main blueprint 10 (3,640), about 23 stages over the week. Progress adds up across runs, stage 4 pays a 50-progress bonus once a day, and tiers reset Mondays 0:00 UTC. Host migration between stages is the usual way a run falls apart. If week 3 is close, wait for it.

disclosures.title: old guides are wrong
disclosures.body: Before Hotfix 31.7.2 the parts were Rotation C only and came from Manics and Tyl Regor. Some databases still list Grineer Manics; they no longer drop Ash.

conditions: Each component costs 15,000 cr. Start each as it drops so the 12-hour timers overlap; have a free Warframe slot before claiming Ash.
The Smoking Body Ephemera consumes a second Ash Systems, and each Circuit week gives only one. Farm the spare in Luckless Expanse.
Keep base Ash even with Ash Prime: subsuming Shuriken needs the base frame.
